notes: Independent exact state-space enumeration of the reported G_7 input found 92 RELAX invocations under every legal minimum-key tie choice; thus even the maximum is below the explicitly claimed 2^7 = 128. Vertex a7 is extracted exactly 8 times, contradicting the proof's T_7 >= 128 recurrence. No vertex is decreased while already queued, so keyed-queue versus duplicate-entry interpretations coincide on this input. The graph has 16 vertices, 22 edges, seven negative edges, and all edges advance in the stated topological order. The refuted per-n lower bound and doubling recurrence are substantive claims driving the proof, not typos the author plainly did not mean. A lone finite input would not refute bare asymptotic notation by itself, but it does refute the solution's explicit universal >= 2^n assertion used to establish that notation.
